subject: merc
label: merc, in the place of the game's models/player/merc/merc.mdl

measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/player/terrorist/terrorist.mdl, models/player/gordon/gordon.mdl, models/player/agent/agent.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 3 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked C, A, C where the asset was A, B, C: passed for one of the game's
measured.contract: keeps the contract the mod's stock players share: their animations at their numbers, their shared bones, attachments and bodyparts

M1.reason: Against the brief's words the outline reads as a merc in a vest with cargo trousers and boots. The vest plate stands off the chest and back in the side and back views, the trousers and boots sit where they should, and the hunched forward stance in motion.png is a pose, not an outline fault.

M2.reason: Height 71.2 against the 69 asked is 3.2% over, well within 15%. Width and depth (25.7 and 25.1) have no size in the brief to check against.

M3.reason: Parts the brief asks for, in order: balaclava (a black head, present, though it reads as a solid dome with no face opening), vest (present, grey plate front and back), vest pouches (two black pouches on the front plate in front-left and front-right), belt gear pouches (black pouches at both hips in front, left and right views, present), cargo trousers (tan trousers present but no cargo pockets in any of the ten views: the legs are plain, the camo paint is blotchy and shows no pocket shape), boots (present, black). The cargo pockets are a small part the brief names and they are missing in shape and paint, so M3 is capped at 1.

M4.reason: Black balaclava head, olive jacket, grey vest, tan camo trousers, black boots and pouches: each region reads as its material (cloth, plate, boot leather) and matches what the brief asks. The brief gives no colour for the jacket, so olive is not contrary to it.

M5.reason: The pouches are visible as dark blocks on the vest and belt, the vest's plate has a mottled grey surface, and the trousers carry a camo pattern. The brief asks for no lettering or stripes, so the surface detail it does ask for (pouches, vest) is there at a similar sharpness.

M6.reason: Capped at 2 by the line-up test, as set for this judging. The asset was picked as one of the game's in the line-up.

M7.reason: The front view faces forward, the figure stands upright in the side and below views, and its boots sit on the floor line in motion.png and the run frames.

M8.reason: Triangle count 1076 is well under twice the median of 1733. Check errors are empty. In the back, back-left and back-right views a small black triangle sits at the heel of each boot, read as boot detail, not an open face. The underside shows open boot soles, but the underside is never seen in the game, so it is not charged.

C1.reason: In the run (motion.png, frames 0 to 30) the legs swing from the hips, the arms and vest stay on the torso, and nothing sinks or floats. In the stunt (forward dive, frames 0 to 35) the body goes flat with the boots and vest staying attached through the whole dive.

C2.reason: The measured contract check reports the asset keeps the stock player contract: every bone, animation at its number, attachment and bodypart of the base, with no fault found.
